title: kith-events: EventSource endpoint
description:
What: Implement GET /jmap/events axum SSE handler (Owner-only, types/closeafter params, broadcast subscription) and register route in kithd main.rs.

Algorithm:
1. crates/kith-events/src/lib.rs - define EventsQuery { types: Option<String>, closeafter: Option<String>, ping: Option<u64> } with #[derive(Deserialize)]
2. Implement pub async fn events_handler<W>(caller: Caller, State(state): State<AppState<W>>, Query(params): Query<EventsQuery>) -> impl IntoResponse:
   a. If caller.role != Role::Owner return StatusCode::FORBIDDEN immediately
   b. Parse params.types (comma-sep): validate each token against whitelist ["Contact","Chat","Message"]; return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "unknown type") for any unknown
   c. Validate params.closeafter: accept only "state", "no", or absent; return 400 otherwise
   d. let rx = state.events_tx.subscribe()
   e. Build stream: BroadcastStream::new(rx).filter_map(|result| { match result { Ok(sc) => if types_filter_passes(&sc.type_name, &allowed_types) { let data = serde_json::json!({"changed":{"a-self":{&sc.type_name: &sc.new_state}}}).to_string(); Some(Ok(Event::default().event("state").data(data).id(&sc.new_state))) } else { None }, Err(BroadcastStreamRecvError::Lagged(n)) => { tracing::debug!("SSE receiver lagged {n} messages"); None } } })
   f. If closeafter == Some("state"): wrap stream with .take(1)
   g. Return Sse::new(stream).keep_alive(KeepAlive::new().interval(Duration::from_secs(15)))
3. crates/kithd/src/main.rs: in router builder add .route("/jmap/events", get(events_handler::<W>)); kithd must add kith-events dep and import handler

Defensive rules:
- Auth check is FIRST line of handler; return 403 before any channel subscription
- All SSE event data JSON constructed via serde_json (never manual string concat)
- Lagged broadcast: log at debug level and skip; never return Err to client stream (would close SSE)
- types whitelist is case-sensitive; only exactly "Contact","Chat","Message" are valid
